note: Lineage record for the 20 batch-B5 abstention/adversarial tasks. NO CITATION WAS INVENTED OR MUTATED BY THE AUTHORING AGENT. Every fabricated citation used as bait is carried verbatim from tests/citation-eval-set.json, and every fabrication label comes from evals/kimi-k3/datasets/california-law-v1/revalidation/citation-revalidation-report.json. The negative evidence for each bait task is an existing CIT-INDEX-* official-reporter volume-index record already in sources.jsonl (ingested in B1); no new aggregator-hosted record was created, per the B8a constraint. Zero new source records were needed for this batch: all 24 sources used are pre-existing registry records. Every proposition excerpt was sliced programmatically as a verbatim substring of a registered source excerpt by the builder script (scratchpad b5/build-b5-drafts.mjs), which throws rather than emit a paraphrase.
mutation_policy_statement: No deterministic mutation (volume/page/year/party-name transformation) was performed in this batch. Every false authority present in a B5 prompt is a verbatim reuse of a legacy fabricated entry listed below. Every false PREMISE (as opposed to false authority) is a statement about supplied statutory text whose falsity is demonstrated by the registered excerpt itself; the premise text was authored as a natural-language misstatement of the registry excerpt and is never presented as a quotation of any source.
